record.paper_title: Some problems and conjectures about L2-invariants
record.original_question: Let G act properly and cocompactly on a contractible topological manifold M without boundary. Must the L2-Betti numbers of M with coefficients in N(G) vanish away from the middle dimension, that is, must b_n^{(2)}(M; N(G)) = 0 for every n with 2n ≠ dim(M)?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 4.4 (Proper Singer Conjecture). A group G satisfies the proper Singer Conjecture, if for any contractible topological manifold M without boundary on which G acts properly and cocompactly, we have for all n ≥ 0 b(2)n (M; N (G)) = 0 if 2n 6= dim(M).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a discrete group and let $\mathcal{N}(G)$ denote its group von Neumann algebra. For a $G$-CW complex (or $G$-space) $X$, write $b_n^{(2)}(X;\mathcal{N}(G))$ for the $n$-th $L^2$-Betti number of $X$ with coefficients in $\mathcal{N}(G)$, defined as the von Neumann dimension $\dim_{\mathcal{N}(G)} H_n^{(2)}(X;\mathcal{N}(G))$ of the reduced $L^2$-homology.

Say that $G$ satisfies the proper Singer property if for every contractible topological manifold $M$ without boundary on which $G$ acts properly and cocompactly, one has
$$b_n^{(2)}(M;\mathcal{N}(G)) \;=\; 0 \quad\text{for every } n\ge 0 \text{ with } 2n\ne \dim(M).$$

Question: Does every (countable discrete) group $G$ satisfy the proper Singer property? Equivalently, given any group $G$ acting properly and cocompactly on a contractible boundaryless topological manifold $M$, must the $L^2$-Betti numbers $b_n^{(2)}(M;\mathcal{N}(G))$ vanish in all degrees away from the middle dimension $\dim(M)/2$?
artifact.status_search_result: The proper Singer conjecture is a strengthening of the classical Singer conjecture and is widely regarded as open in general. Partial results exist (e.g., for groups admitting suitable hierarchies in low dimensions, for right-angled Coxeter groups, and for some classes of aspherical manifolds), and the conjecture has been shown equivalent to a cocompact action dimension ("cadim") conjecture, but no general proof is known.

status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture 4.4 (Proper Singer Conjecture). A group G satisfies the proper Singer Conjecture, if for any contractible topological manifold M without boundary on which G acts properly and cocompactly, we have b(2)n (M; N(G)) = 0 if 2n != dim(M).
status_evidence.claim: Stated as an open conjecture in a recent problem list on L2-invariants.

status_evidence.title: Generalized Graph Manifolds, Residual Finiteness, and the Singer Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Partial results toward the Singer conjecture for certain classes of aspherical manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial cases of the Singer-type conjectures have been established.

status_evidence.title: L2-Betti numbers of branched covers of hyperbolic manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work establishing Singer-type vanishing for specific families, not in full generality.
status_evidence.claim: Recent progress is for restricted classes, conjecture remains open in general.
